templates.description: R&D capability and capital investment transmission into compute capacity, model efficiency, and downstream sectoral adoption.
Export restrictions on leading-edge lithography and high-bandwidth memory cap frontier training cluster scaling despite capital surges.
Interconnection queues and regional baseload power bottlenecks throttle datacenter deployment speed relative to chip shipments.
Lower inference cost per token accelerates enterprise workflow integration and triggers Jevons-style aggregate compute demand growth.
